{"rules": ["Model consistently underestimates price during high-volatility regimes characterized by low sentiment (0.00) and erratic historical ranges.", "Forecast exhibits severe lag; it fails to capture immediate spikes when true outcomes jump >15% above the last known price while sentiment remains neutral or slightly positive.", "Systematic bias toward mean reversion: model predicts a slow, linear decline even when recent history shows strong upward momentum despite low sentiment scores.", "When sentiment shifts from 0.00 to 0.20 or 0.33, the model fails to adjust its trajectory, continuing to project downward trends that are quickly reversed by true outcomes.", "Forecast horizon is too conservative; it assumes a floor near recent lows (75-80 range) whereas true outcomes frequently breach 90-100 in the same period.", "Correction heuristic: Apply an upward bias multiplier of 1.2x to the model's forecast when sentiment is <= 0.20 and the last 3 days show a price increase >5%.", "If the model predicts a decline while the true outcome history shows a V-shape recovery within 5 days, reverse the forecast direction immediately."]
